items.question: Trong câu "Clients speak a simple protocol (RESP) over TCP, default port 6379, and every value is a real data structure — string, hash, list, set, sorted set, stream — with server-side commands that operate on it atomically.", từ "atomically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clients speak a simple protocol (RESP) over TCP, default port 6379, and every value is a real data structure — string, hash, list, set, sorted set, stream — with server-side commands that operate on it atomically.", what does "atomically" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách nguyên tử, trọn vẹn
một cách song song, đồng thời
một cách tự động, định kỳ
ở cấp độ vật lý hạt nhân
optionsEn: in parallel, at the same time
at the level of nuclear physics
items.explanation: atomically /əˈtɒm.ɪ.kli/ (trạng từ): một cách nguyên tử, trọn vẹn. Thao tác "atomically" thì hoặc chạy trọn vẹn, hoặc không chạy; không client nào thấy trạng thái nửa chừng.
items.explanationEn: atomically /əˈtɒm.ɪ.kli/ (adverb): as one indivisible step. An operation done atomically either completes fully or not at all; no client sees a half-finished state.

items.question: Trong câu "It is not your system of record: RAM is expensive and durability is configurable, not guaranteed.", từ "durability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is not your system of record: RAM is expensive and durability is configurable, not guaranteed.", what does "durability" (noun) mean?
options: độ sẵn sàng của hệ thống
độ bền vật lý của đồ vật
tốc độ xử lý dữ liệu
items.explanation: durability /ˌdjʊə.rəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): độ bền của dữ liệu. Trong cơ sở dữ liệu, "durability" là chữ D trong ACID: dữ liệu đã ghi thì không bị mất.
items.explanationEn: durability /ˌdjʊə.rəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): data surviving crashes and restarts. In databases, durability is the D in ACID: once written, data is not lost.

items.question: Trong câu "It is not your system of record: RAM is expensive and durability is configurable, not guaranteed.", từ "configurable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is not your system of record: RAM is expensive and durability is configurable, not guaranteed.", what does "configurable" (adjective) mean?
options: có thể mở rộng quy mô
items.explanation: configurable /kənˈfɪɡ.ər.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): tuỳ chỉnh được. "X is configurable" = người vận hành tự chọn mức X qua cấu hình, không phải mặc định cố định.
items.explanationEn: configurable /kənˈfɪɡ.ər.ə.bəl/ (adjective): set by configuration. "X is configurable" means operators choose the level of X through settings rather than a fixed default.

items.question: Trong câu "For application code they are interchangeable today.", từ "interchangeable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For application code they are interchangeable today.", what does "interchangeable" (adjective) mean?
options: có thể thay thế cho nhau
optionsEn: able to be swapped for each other
items.explanation: interchangeable /ˌɪn.təˈtʃeɪn.dʒə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể thay thế cho nhau. Hai thứ "interchangeable" thì đổi cái này sang cái kia mà code không cần sửa.
items.explanationEn: interchangeable /ˌɪn.təˈtʃeɪn.dʒə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be swapped for each other. Two interchangeable things can replace each other without changing the code.

items.question: Trong câu "On AWS, ElastiCache and MemoryDB offer Valkey alongside Redis OSS.", từ "alongside" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On AWS, ElastiCache and MemoryDB offer Valkey alongside Redis OSS.", what does "alongside" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: alongside /əˌlɒŋˈsaɪd/ (giới từ): cùng với. "Offer A alongside B" = cung cấp A cùng lúc với B, người dùng chọn cái nào cũng được.
items.explanationEn: alongside /əˌlɒŋˈsaɪd/ (preposition): together with. "Offer A alongside B" means providing both at the same time, so users can pick either.

items.question: Trong câu "The Linux Foundation forked the last BSD release (7.2.4) as Valkey, which is command-compatible; Redis 8 (2025) added AGPLv3 as another option.", từ "fork" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Linux Foundation forked the last BSD release (7.2.4) as Valkey, which is command-compatible; Redis 8 (2025) added AGPLv3 as another option.", what does "fork" (verb) mean?
options: tách nhánh thành dự án riêng
gộp mã nguồn vào nhánh chính
xoá một bản phát hành cũ
optionsEn: to copy code into a new project
to merge code into the main branch
items.explanation: fork /fɔːk/ (động từ): tách nhánh thành dự án riêng. "Fork a project" = sao chép mã nguồn để phát triển độc lập; ở phần sau "fork()" còn là tạo tiến trình con.
items.explanationEn: fork /fɔːk/ (verb): to copy code into a new project. "Fork a project" means copying its code to develop it independently; later, fork() also means creating a child process.

items.question: Trong câu "An event loop (epoll on Linux) multiplexes thousands of sockets; each ready command is executed to completion, then the next one runs.", từ "multiplex" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An event loop (epoll on Linux) multiplexes thousands of sockets; each ready command is executed to completion, then the next one runs.", what does "multiplex" (verb) mean?
options: nhân bản thành nhiều bản sao
chia nhỏ thành nhiều gói tin
items.explanation: multiplex /ˈmʌl.tɪ.pleks/ (động từ): ghép nhiều kênh vào một. Một luồng "multiplexes" nhiều socket: nó theo dõi tất cả và xử lý socket nào sẵn sàng.
items.explanationEn: multiplex /ˈmʌl.tɪ.pleks/ (verb): to combine many channels. One thread that multiplexes many sockets watches all of them and serves whichever is ready.

items.question: Trong câu "An event loop (epoll on Linux) multiplexes thousands of sockets; each ready command is executed to completion, then the next one runs.", từ "completion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An event loop (epoll on Linux) multiplexes thousands of sockets; each ready command is executed to completion, then the next one runs.", what does "completion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: completion /kəmˈpliː.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự hoàn tất, làm xong. "Run to completion" = chạy đến khi xong hẳn rồi mới chuyển sang việc khác.
items.explanationEn: completion /kəmˈpliː.ʃən/ (noun): being finished. "Run to completion" means running until fully finished before switching to anything else.

items.question: Trong câu "This is fast because there are no locks or context switches and the real bottleneck is network and memory, not CPU.", từ "bottleneck" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is fast because there are no locks or context switches and the real bottleneck is network and memory, not CPU.", what does "bottleneck" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the narrow neck of a bottle
items.explanation: bottleneck /ˈbɒt.əl.nek/ (danh từ): điểm nghẽn hiệu năng. Tăng CPU không giúp gì nếu "bottleneck" nằm ở mạng; hãy tối ưu chỗ nghẽn thật.
items.explanationEn: bottleneck /ˈbɒt.əl.nek/ (noun): the limiting factor. Adding CPU does not help if the bottleneck is the network; optimise the real limit.

items.question: Trong câu "And every command is atomic by construction.", từ "by construction" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "And every command is atomic by construction.", what does "by construction" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: guaranteed by how it is designed
items.explanation: by construction /baɪ kənˈstrʌk.ʃən/ (cụm từ): nhờ chính thiết kế. "X by construction" = tính chất X có sẵn nhờ thiết kế, không cần thêm cơ chế nào.
items.explanationEn: by construction /baɪ kənˈstrʌk.ʃən/ (phrase): guaranteed by how it is designed. "X by construction" means the property follows from the design itself, with no extra mechanism.

items.question: Trong câu "The flip side: one slow command blocks every client.", từ "the flip side" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The flip side: one slow command blocks every client.", what does "the flip side" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: the flip side /ðə flɪp saɪd/ (cụm từ): mặt trái. "The flip side" dùng để nêu cái giá phải trả của một ưu điểm vừa nhắc.
items.explanationEn: the flip side /ðə flɪp saɪd/ (phrase): the downside. "The flip side" introduces the cost of an advantage just mentioned.

items.question: Trong câu "Batching tools: pipelining sends many commands in one round trip (not atomic); MULTI/EXEC runs queued commands without interleaving (no rollback); Lua scripts (EVAL) or Redis 7 Functions run read-modify-write logic atomically.", từ "interleave" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Batching tools: pipelining sends many commands in one round trip (not atomic); MULTI/EXEC runs queued commands without interleaving (no rollback); Lua scripts (EVAL) or Redis 7 Functions run read-modify-write logic atomically.", what does "interleave" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: interleave /ˌɪn.təˈliːv/ (động từ): xen kẽ nhau. "Without interleaving" = không có lệnh của client khác chen vào giữa các lệnh trong hàng đợi.
items.explanationEn: interleave /ˌɪn.təˈliːv/ (verb): to mix together. "Without interleaving" means no other client's command slips in between the queued ones.

items.question: Trong câu "Batching tools: pipelining sends many commands in one round trip (not atomic); MULTI/EXEC runs queued commands without interleaving (no rollback); Lua scripts (EVAL) or Redis 7 Functions run read-modify-write logic atomically.", từ "round trip" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Batching tools: pipelining sends many commands in one round trip (not atomic); MULTI/EXEC runs queued commands without interleaving (no rollback); Lua scripts (EVAL) or Redis 7 Functions run read-modify-write logic atomically.", what does "round trip" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: round trip /ˈraʊnd trɪp/ (cụm từ): một lượt gửi và nhận. Mỗi "round trip" tốn độ trễ mạng, nên gom nhiều lệnh vào một lượt sẽ nhanh hơn.
items.explanationEn: round trip /ˈraʊnd trɪp/ (phrase): one request and its reply. Each round trip costs network latency, so batching commands into one is faster.

items.question: Trong câu "The data does not fit in RAM affordably", từ "affordably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The data does not fit in RAM affordably", what does "affordably" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: affordably /əˈfɔː.də.bli/ (trạng từ): với chi phí hợp lý. RAM đắt, nên dữ liệu quá lớn thì không "fit in RAM affordably" (không vừa túi tiền).
items.explanationEn: affordably /əˈfɔː.də.bli/ (adverb): at a reasonable cost. RAM is costly, so very large data cannot fit in RAM affordably.

items.question: Trong câu "The keyspace is a flat dictionary; the convention is colon-separated names like user:42:profile.", từ "convention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The keyspace is a flat dictionary; the convention is colon-separated names like user:42:profile.", what does "convention" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (danh từ): quy ước chung. "Naming convention" = quy ước đặt tên mà mọi người tự nguyện tuân theo, Redis không ép buộc.
items.explanationEn: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (noun): a common practice. A naming convention is a practice people follow voluntarily; Redis does not enforce it.

items.question: Trong câu "The keyspace is a flat dictionary; the convention is colon-separated names like user:42:profile.", từ "flat" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The keyspace is a flat dictionary; the convention is colon-separated names like user:42:profile.", what does "flat" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: flat /flæt/ (tính từ): không phân cấp. "Flat namespace" = mọi key cùng một cấp; dấu ":" chỉ là quy ước, không tạo thư mục thật.
items.explanationEn: flat /flæt/ (adjective): having no nested levels. A flat namespace puts all keys on one level; colons are just convention, not real folders.

items.question: Trong câu "Strings are binary-safe up to 512 MB, though values beyond a few KB are a smell.", từ "smell" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strings are binary-safe up to 512 MB, though values beyond a few KB are a smell.", what does "smell" (noun) mean?
options: dấu hiệu thiết kế có vấn đề
giới hạn cứng của hệ thống
optionsEn: a sign of a design problem
an odour sensed by the nose
items.explanation: smell /smel/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu thiết kế có vấn đề. Trong lập trình, "code smell" là dấu hiệu cảnh báo chứ chưa hẳn là lỗi.
items.explanationEn: smell /smel/ (noun): a sign of a design problem. In programming, a "code smell" is a warning sign rather than a definite bug.

items.question: Trong câu "INCR beats "read, add one, write back" in application code: the increment happens on the single thread, so concurrent clients never lose an update.", từ "concurrent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "INCR beats "read, add one, write back" in application code: the increment happens on the single thread, so concurrent clients never lose an update.", what does "concurrent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (tính từ): chạy đồng thời. "Concurrent clients" = nhiều client thao tác cùng lúc; dễ gây mất cập nhật nếu không nguyên tử.
items.explanationEn: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (adjective): running at the same time. Concurrent clients act at the same time, which can lose updates without atomic operations.

items.question: Trong câu "INCR beats "read, add one, write back" in application code: the increment happens on the single thread, so concurrent clients never lose an update.", từ "increment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "INCR beats "read, add one, write back" in application code: the increment happens on the single thread, so concurrent clients never lose an update.", what does "increment" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a decrease by a set amount
an increase by a set amount
items.explanation: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.mənt/ (danh từ): phép tăng thêm. Động từ "increment" = tăng lên; ngược lại là "decrement" (giảm đi).
items.explanationEn: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.mənt/ (noun): an increase by a set amount. The verb "increment" means to increase; the opposite is "decrement".

items.question: Trong câu "Hash — a map of fields inside one key, ideal for objects updated field by field.", từ "ideal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hash — a map of fields inside one key, ideal for objects updated field by field.", what does "ideal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ideal /aɪˈdɪəl/ (tính từ): lý tưởng, rất phù hợp. "Ideal for X" = cực kỳ phù hợp cho X; đồng nghĩa "well suited for".
items.explanationEn: ideal /aɪˈdɪəl/ (adjective): perfectly suited. "Ideal for X" means extremely well suited for X.

items.question: Trong câu "List — ordered sequence; O(1) push/pop at both ends, O(N) index access in the middle.", từ "sequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "List — ordered sequence; O(1) push/pop at both ends, O(N) index access in the middle.", what does "sequence" (noun) mean?
options: dãy phần tử theo thứ tự
optionsEn: a series of items in order
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (danh từ): dãy phần tử theo thứ tự. "Ordered sequence" nhấn mạnh thứ tự các phần tử được giữ nguyên.
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (noun): a series of items in order. "Ordered sequence" stresses that the items keep their order.

items.question: Trong câu "Set — unordered unique members; O(1) add/remove/membership plus set algebra.", từ "membership" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Set — unordered unique members; O(1) add/remove/membership plus set algebra.", what does "membership" (noun) mean?
options: tư cách hội viên câu lạc bộ
optionsEn: being a member of a club
items.explanation: membership /ˈmem.bə.ʃɪp/ (danh từ): việc kiểm tra thuộc tập. "Membership test" trong cấu trúc dữ liệu = kiểm tra một giá trị có nằm trong tập hay không.
items.explanationEn: membership /ˈmem.bə.ʃɪp/ (noun): checking if it belongs. In data structures, a membership test checks whether a value is in the set.

items.question: Trong câu "Small collections use a compact listpack encoding and convert to full hash tables/skiplists past a size threshold — so many small hashes use far less memory than many separate string keys.", từ "compact" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Small collections use a compact listpack encoding and convert to full hash tables/skiplists past a size threshold — so many small hashes use far less memory than many separate string keys.", what does "compact" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: compact /kəmˈpækt/ (tính từ): gọn, chiếm ít chỗ. "Compact encoding" = cách mã hoá tiết kiệm bộ nhớ, thường đổi lại tốc độ khi dữ liệu lớn.
items.explanationEn: compact /kəmˈpækt/ (adjective): taking up little space. A compact encoding saves memory, usually trading speed once data grows.

items.question: Trong câu "Small collections use a compact listpack encoding and convert to full hash tables/skiplists past a size threshold — so many small hashes use far less memory than many separate string keys.", từ "threshold" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Small collections use a compact listpack encoding and convert to full hash tables/skiplists past a size threshold — so many small hashes use far less memory than many separate string keys.", what does "threshold" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: threshold /ˈθreʃ.həʊld/ (danh từ): ngưỡng giới hạn. "Past a threshold" = vượt quá ngưỡng thì hành vi thay đổi (ở đây là đổi cách mã hoá).
items.explanationEn: threshold /ˈθreʃ.həʊld/ (noun): a cut-off level. "Past a threshold" means behaviour changes once a limit is exceeded (here, the encoding).

items.question: Trong câu "A sorted set (ZSET) holds unique members with a floating-point score, ordered by score.", từ "floating-point" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sorted set (ZSET) holds unique members with a floating-point score, ordered by score.", what does "floating-point" (adjective) mean?
options: giá trị trôi nổi, thay đổi
items.explanation: floating-point /ˌfləʊ.tɪŋ ˈpɔɪnt/ (tính từ): số thực dấu phẩy động. "Floating-point score" = điểm là số thực như 1500.5, không chỉ số nguyên.
items.explanationEn: floating-point /ˌfləʊ.tɪŋ ˈpɔɪnt/ (adjective): a real decimal number. A floating-point score can be a real number like 1500.5, not only an integer.

items.question: Trong câu "It pairs a skiplist (ordered traversal) with a hash table (O(1) score lookup), so ZADD, ZREM and ZRANK are O(log N) and range reads O(log N + M).", từ "pair" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It pairs a skiplist (ordered traversal) with a hash table (O(1) score lookup), so ZADD, ZREM and ZRANK are O(log N) and range reads O(log N + M).", what does "pair" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: pair /peə/ (động từ): kết hợp theo cặp. "Pair A with B" = dùng A cùng B để bổ sung ưu điểm cho nhau.
items.explanationEn: pair /peə/ (verb): to combine two things together. "Pair A with B" means using them together so each covers the other's weakness.

items.question: Trong câu "It pairs a skiplist (ordered traversal) with a hash table (O(1) score lookup), so ZADD, ZREM and ZRANK are O(log N) and range reads O(log N + M).", từ "traversal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It pairs a skiplist (ordered traversal) with a hash table (O(1) score lookup), so ZADD, ZREM and ZRANK are O(log N) and range reads O(log N + M).", what does "traversal" (noun) mean?
options: việc xoá toàn bộ phần tử
items.explanation: traversal /trəˈvɜː.səl/ (danh từ): việc duyệt tuần tự. Động từ "traverse" = duyệt; "ordered traversal" = duyệt theo thứ tự đã sắp.
items.explanationEn: traversal /trəˈvɜː.səl/ (noun): visiting items in turn. The verb is "traverse"; an ordered traversal visits items in sorted order.

items.question: Trong câu "A timestamp score turns a sorted set into a time index — the basis of delayed-job queues and sliding-window rate limiters.", từ "basis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A timestamp score turns a sorted set into a time index — the basis of delayed-job queues and sliding-window rate limiters.", what does "basis" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: basis /ˈbeɪ.sɪs/ (danh từ): nền tảng, cơ sở. "The basis of X" = nền tảng để xây dựng X; cụm quen thuộc: "on a daily basis" (hằng ngày).
items.explanationEn: basis /ˈbeɪ.sɪs/ (noun): the foundation. "The basis of X" is what X is built on; compare "on a daily basis".

items.question: Trong câu "Fine for invalidation broadcasts and live notifications.", từ "invalidation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fine for invalidation broadcasts and live notifications.", what does "invalidation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: invalidation /ɪnˌvæl.ɪˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): việc huỷ bản đệm cũ. "Cache invalidation" = báo cho các node rằng bản đệm đã cũ, cần xoá hoặc tải lại.
items.explanationEn: invalidation /ɪnˌvæl.ɪˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): marking cache as stale. Cache invalidation tells nodes a cached copy is stale and must be dropped or reloaded.

items.question: Trong câu "Redis 7 added sharded pub/sub (SPUBLISH/SSUBSCRIBE) so cluster messages are not broadcast to every node.", từ "broadcast" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Redis 7 added sharded pub/sub (SPUBLISH/SSUBSCRIBE) so cluster messages are not broadcast to every node.", what does "broadcast" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: broadcast /ˈbrɔːd.kɑːst/ (động từ): phát tới mọi nơi nhận. Quá khứ của "broadcast" vẫn là "broadcast"; trái nghĩa gần là "unicast" (gửi một đích).
items.explanationEn: broadcast /ˈbrɔːd.kɑːst/ (verb): to send to every receiver. The past form of "broadcast" is also "broadcast"; the opposite idea is unicast.

items.question: Trong câu "Each group keeps a Pending Entries List (PEL) of delivered-but-unacked entries, giving at-least-once processing.", từ "pending" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each group keeps a Pending Entries List (PEL) of delivered-but-unacked entries, giving at-least-once processing.", what does "pending" (adjective) mean?
options: đang chờ xử lý, chưa xong
items.explanation: pending /ˈpen.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): đang chờ xử lý, chưa xong. "Pending" = còn treo, chưa hoàn tất; ví dụ "pending requests", "pending approval".
items.explanationEn: pending /ˈpen.dɪŋ/ (adjective): waiting to be completed. "Pending" means not yet finished, as in "pending requests" or "pending approval".

items.question: Trong câu "Streams suit moderate volumes when you already run Redis; for long retention and very high throughput see Kafka in topic 11.", từ "suit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Streams suit moderate volumes when you already run Redis; for long retention and very high throughput see Kafka in topic 11.", what does "suit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suit /suːt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. "X suits Y" = X hợp với Y; tính từ liên quan: "suitable" (phù hợp).
items.explanationEn: suit /suːt/ (verb): to be right for. "X suits Y" means X is right for Y; related adjective: "suitable".

items.question: Trong câu "Streams suit moderate volumes when you already run Redis; for long retention and very high throughput see Kafka in topic 11.", từ "moderate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Streams suit moderate volumes when you already run Redis; for long retention and very high throughput see Kafka in topic 11.", what does "moderate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: moderate /ˈmɒd.ər.ət/ (tính từ): vừa phải. "Moderate volumes" = lưu lượng vừa phải; động từ "moderate" lại có nghĩa kiểm duyệt.
items.explanationEn: moderate /ˈmɒd.ər.ət/ (adjective): medium-sized. "Moderate volumes" are medium-sized loads; the verb "moderate" means to supervise content.

items.question: Trong câu "Streams suit moderate volumes when you already run Redis; for long retention and very high throughput see Kafka in topic 11.", từ "retention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Streams suit moderate volumes when you already run Redis; for long retention and very high throughput see Kafka in topic 11.", what does "retention" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: retention /rɪˈten.ʃən/ (danh từ): việc lưu giữ lâu dài. "Retention period" = khoảng thời gian dữ liệu được giữ lại trước khi xoá.
items.explanationEn: retention /rɪˈten.ʃən/ (noun): keeping data over time. A retention period is how long data is kept before deletion.

items.question: Trong câu "Streams suit moderate volumes when you already run Redis; for long retention and very high throughput see Kafka in topic 11.", từ "throughput" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Streams suit moderate volumes when you already run Redis; for long retention and very high throughput see Kafka in topic 11.", what does "throughput" (noun) mean?
options: băng thông tối đa lý thuyết
optionsEn: work handled per unit of time
items.explanation: throughput /ˈθruː.pʊt/ (danh từ): thông lượng xử lý. "High throughput" = xử lý được nhiều thông điệp/yêu cầu mỗi giây; khác với "latency" (độ trễ).
items.explanationEn: throughput /ˈθruː.pʊt/ (noun): work handled per unit of time. High throughput means many messages per second; it differs from latency, the delay of each.

items.question: Trong câu "Gotcha: a plain SET on an existing key discards its TTL unless you pass EX/PX/KEEPTTL; INCR and HSET keep it.", từ "discard" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gotcha: a plain SET on an existing key discards its TTL unless you pass EX/PX/KEEPTTL; INCR and HSET keep it.", what does "discard" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (động từ): loại bỏ, vứt bỏ. "Discard changes" = bỏ các thay đổi; ở đây SET âm thầm bỏ mất TTL cũ.
items.explanationEn: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (verb): to throw away. "Discard changes" means dropping them; here SET silently drops the old TTL.

items.question: Trong câu "Gotcha: a plain SET on an existing key discards its TTL unless you pass EX/PX/KEEPTTL; INCR and HSET keep it.", từ "gotcha" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gotcha: a plain SET on an existing key discards its TTL unless you pass EX/PX/KEEPTTL; INCR and HSET keep it.", what does "gotcha" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gotcha /ˈɡɒtʃ.ə/ (danh từ): cái bẫy dễ mắc. "Gotcha" (từ "got you") = chi tiết bất ngờ khiến người dùng mắc lỗi.
items.explanationEn: gotcha /ˈɡɒtʃ.ə/ (noun): a hidden trap. "Gotcha" (from "got you") is a surprising detail that trips people up.

items.question: Trong câu "Expired keys are removed lazily (when accessed) and actively (a background cycle samples keys with TTLs and deletes expired ones).", từ "lazily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Expired keys are removed lazily (when accessed) and actively (a background cycle samples keys with TTLs and deletes expired ones).", what does "lazily" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: lazily /ˈleɪ.zɪ.li/ (trạng từ): chỉ khi cần đến. Trong kỹ thuật, "lazy" = trì hoãn công việc tới khi cần, như "lazy loading".
items.explanationEn: lazily /ˈleɪ.zɪ.li/ (adverb): only when actually needed. In engineering, "lazy" means deferring work until needed, as in lazy loading.

items.question: Trong câu "Memory is reclaimed promptly, not instantly.", từ "reclaim" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Memory is reclaimed promptly, not instantly.", what does "reclaim" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reclaim /rɪˈkleɪm/ (động từ): thu hồi lại (tài nguyên). "Reclaim memory" = lấy lại bộ nhớ đã giải phóng để dùng tiếp.
items.explanationEn: reclaim /rɪˈkleɪm/ (verb): to recover for reuse. "Reclaim memory" means getting freed memory back for reuse.

items.question: Trong câu "Memory is reclaimed promptly, not instantly.", từ "promptly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Memory is reclaimed promptly, not instantly.", what does "promptly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: promptly /ˈprɒmpt.li/ (trạng từ): khá nhanh. Câu phân biệt "promptly" (sớm) với "instantly" (tức thì): có độ trễ nhỏ.
items.explanationEn: promptly /ˈprɒmpt.li/ (adverb): quickly, without undue delay. The sentence contrasts promptly (soon) with instantly (at once): a small delay exists.

items.question: Trong câu "Keys written together with the same TTL also expire together — add jitter (stampede handling is topic 10).", từ "jitter" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keys written together with the same TTL also expire together — add jitter (stampede handling is topic 10).", what does "jitter" (noun) mean?
options: sự rung lắc do lo lắng
items.explanation: jitter /ˈdʒɪt.ə/ (danh từ): độ lệch ngẫu nhiên nhỏ. "Add jitter" = cộng thêm vài giây ngẫu nhiên vào TTL để key không hết hạn cùng lúc.
items.explanationEn: jitter /ˈdʒɪt.ə/ (noun): random variation. "Add jitter" means adding a few random seconds so keys do not expire at once.

items.question: Trong câu "Keys written together with the same TTL also expire together — add jitter (stampede handling is topic 10).", từ "stampede" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keys written together with the same TTL also expire together — add jitter (stampede handling is topic 10).", what does "stampede" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stampede /stæmˈpiːd/ (danh từ): cơn dồn dập yêu cầu. "Cache stampede" = nhiều request cùng lúc bị miss cache và dồn vào database.
items.explanationEn: stampede /stæmˈpiːd/ (noun): a rush of requests. A cache stampede is many requests missing the cache at once and hitting the database.

items.question: Trong câu "maxmemory caps the dataset; maxmemory-policy decides what happens at the limit.", từ "cap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "maxmemory caps the dataset; maxmemory-policy decides what happens at the limit.", what does "cap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to set an upper limit on
items.explanation: cap /kæp/ (động từ): đặt mức trần. "Cap X at N" = không cho X vượt quá N; danh từ "cap" = mức trần.
items.explanationEn: cap /kæp/ (verb): to set an upper limit on. "Cap X at N" means X may not exceed N; the noun "cap" is the ceiling.

items.question: Trong câu "Keep maxmemory below physical RAM to leave room for fragmentation, replication buffers and fork copy-on-write; watch evicted_keys and mem_fragmentation_ratio in INFO, and find big keys with redis-cli --bigkeys.", từ "fragmentation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep maxmemory below physical RAM to leave room for fragmentation, replication buffers and fork copy-on-write; watch evicted_keys and mem_fragmentation_ratio in INFO, and find big keys with redis-cli --bigkeys.", what does "fragmentation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fragmentation /ˌfræɡ.menˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự phân mảnh. Phân mảnh làm bộ nhớ thực dùng lớn hơn dữ liệu; "fragment" = mảnh vỡ.
items.explanationEn: fragmentation /ˌfræɡ.menˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): memory split into gaps. Fragmentation makes real memory use exceed the data size; a "fragment" is a broken piece.

items.question: Trong câu "RDB — Redis fork()s and the child writes a compact point-in-time snapshot.", từ "snapshot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RDB — Redis fork()s and the child writes a compact point-in-time snapshot.", what does "snapshot" (noun) mean?
options: nhật ký thay đổi liên tục
bản chụp tại một thời điểm
optionsEn: a state copy at a moment
items.explanation: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɒt/ (danh từ): bản chụp tại một thời điểm. "Point-in-time snapshot" = bản sao dữ liệu đúng tại một thời điểm, thay đổi sau đó không có.
items.explanationEn: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɒt/ (noun): a state copy at a moment. A point-in-time snapshot copies data as of one moment; later changes are not in it.

items.question: Trong câu "Copy-on-write duplicates pages modified meanwhile, so a write-heavy instance can need up to ~2× memory during BGSAVE.", từ "duplicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Copy-on-write duplicates pages modified meanwhile, so a write-heavy instance can need up to ~2× memory during BGSAVE.", what does "duplicate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): tạo bản sao. Động từ "duplicate" /-keɪt/ khác danh từ/tính từ "duplicate" /-kət/ (bản trùng).
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to make a copy of. The verb ends in /-keɪt/; the noun and adjective "duplicate" end in /-kət/.

items.question: Trong câu "Copy-on-write duplicates pages modified meanwhile, so a write-heavy instance can need up to ~2× memory during BGSAVE.", từ "meanwhile" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Copy-on-write duplicates pages modified meanwhile, so a write-heavy instance can need up to ~2× memory during BGSAVE.", what does "meanwhile" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: meanwhile /ˈmiːn.waɪl/ (trạng từ): trong lúc đó. "Meanwhile" = trong lúc việc kia đang diễn ra (ở đây: lúc tiến trình con đang ghi snapshot).
items.explanationEn: meanwhile /ˈmiːn.waɪl/ (adverb): in the meantime. "Meanwhile" means while the other thing is happening (here, while the child writes).

items.question: Trong câu "AOF — every write command is appended to a log and replayed on start.", từ "append" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AOF — every write command is appended to a log and replayed on start.", what does "append" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: append /əˈpend/ (động từ): nối thêm vào cuối. "Append-only file" (AOF) = tệp chỉ ghi nối thêm, không sửa phần đã ghi.
items.explanationEn: append /əˈpend/ (verb): to add to the end. An append-only file only adds to the end and never edits earlier content.

items.question: Trong câu "AOF — every write command is appended to a log and replayed on start.", từ "replay" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AOF — every write command is appended to a log and replayed on start.", what does "replay" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: replay /ˌriːˈpleɪ/ (động từ): chạy lại thao tác. "Replay the log" = thực thi lại từng lệnh trong nhật ký để dựng lại dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: replay /ˌriːˈpleɪ/ (verb): to re-run operations. "Replay the log" means re-executing each logged command to rebuild the data.

items.question: Trong câu "The log is compacted by background rewrite; with aof-use-rdb-preamble yes (default) its base is RDB format for fast loading.", từ "compact" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The log is compacted by background rewrite; with aof-use-rdb-preamble yes (default) its base is RDB format for fast loading.", what does "compact" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: compact /kəmˈpækt/ (động từ): thu gọn lại. "Log compaction" = viết lại nhật ký chỉ giữ trạng thái cuối, bỏ các lệnh thừa.
items.explanationEn: compact /kəmˈpækt/ (verb): to shrink, remove waste. Log compaction rewrites a log to keep only the final state, dropping redundant commands.

items.question: Trong câu "Need every write durable with Redis semantics?", từ "durable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Need every write durable with Redis semantics?", what does "durable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: durable /ˈdjʊə.rə.bəl/ (tính từ): bền, không mất. "Durable write" = lần ghi đã xác nhận thì không mất kể cả khi máy sập.
items.explanationEn: durable /ˈdjʊə.rə.bəl/ (adjective): safe from loss. A durable write, once acknowledged, is not lost even if the machine crashes.

items.question: Trong câu "Need every write durable with Redis semantics?", từ "semantics" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Need every write durable with Redis semantics?", what does "semantics" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: semantics /sɪˈmæn.tɪks/ (danh từ): cách hoạt động. "With Redis semantics" = các lệnh hoạt động giống hệt Redis.
items.explanationEn: semantics /sɪˈmæn.tɪks/ (noun): defined behaviour. "With Redis semantics" means the commands behave exactly as in Redis.

items.question: Trong câu "A primary streams writes to replicas (REPLICAOF host port): a full RDB sync first, then the command stream, with partial resync from a backlog after brief disconnects.", từ "backlog" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A primary streams writes to replicas (REPLICAOF host port): a full RDB sync first, then the command stream, with partial resync from a backlog after brief disconnects.", what does "backlog" (noun) mean?
options: bộ đệm lưu các lệnh gần đây
items.explanation: backlog /ˈbæk.lɒɡ/ (danh từ): bộ đệm lưu các lệnh gần đây. Ở đây "backlog" là bộ đệm lệnh gần nhất; trong Agile, "product backlog" là danh sách việc cần làm.
items.explanationEn: backlog /ˈbæk.lɒɡ/ (noun): a buffer of recent commands. Here a backlog is a buffer of recent commands; in Agile, a product backlog is a to-do list.

items.question: Trong câu "Replication is asynchronous: the client is acknowledged before replicas get the write, so failover can lose recent writes.", từ "asynchronous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Replication is asynchronous: the client is acknowledged before replicas get the write, so failover can lose recent writes.", what does "asynchronous" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: not waiting for the other side
items.explanation: asynchronous /eɪˈsɪŋ.krə.nəs/ (tính từ): bất đồng bộ. Sao chép "asynchronous" = trả lời client trước, gửi sang replica sau, nên có thể mất dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: asynchronous /eɪˈsɪŋ.krə.nəs/ (adjective): not waiting for the other side. Asynchronous replication replies first and ships to replicas later, so data can be lost.

items.question: Trong câu "Replication is asynchronous: the client is acknowledged before replicas get the write, so failover can lose recent writes.", từ "acknowledge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Replication is asynchronous: the client is acknowledged before replicas get the write, so failover can lose recent writes.", what does "acknowledge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: acknowledge /əkˈnɒl.ɪdʒ/ (động từ): xác nhận đã nhận. Viết tắt "ack" = xác nhận; "acknowledged write" là lần ghi đã báo thành công.
items.explanationEn: acknowledge /əkˈnɒl.ɪdʒ/ (verb): to confirm receipt. Short form "ack"; an acknowledged write is one reported as successful.

items.question: Trong câu "WAIT 1 100 narrows the window but does not make Redis strongly consistent; min-replicas-to-write makes a primary refuse writes when too few replicas are connected.", từ "narrow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "WAIT 1 100 narrows the window but does not make Redis strongly consistent; min-replicas-to-write makes a primary refuse writes when too few replicas are connected.", what does "narrow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: narrow /ˈnær.əʊ/ (động từ): thu hẹp lại. "Narrow the window" = giảm khoảng thời gian có thể xảy ra rủi ro, nhưng không loại bỏ.
items.explanationEn: narrow /ˈnær.əʊ/ (verb): to make smaller. "Narrow the window" shrinks the risky time period without removing it.

items.question: Trong câu "WAIT 1 100 narrows the window but does not make Redis strongly consistent; min-replicas-to-write makes a primary refuse writes when too few replicas are connected.", từ "consistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "WAIT 1 100 narrows the window but does not make Redis strongly consistent; min-replicas-to-write makes a primary refuse writes when too few replicas are connected.", what does "consistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: consistent /kənˈsɪs.tənt/ (tính từ): nhất quán. "Strongly consistent" = mọi lần đọc thấy ngay lần ghi mới nhất; ngược lại là "eventually consistent".
items.explanationEn: consistent /kənˈsɪs.tənt/ (adjective): in agreement. Strongly consistent means every read sees the latest write; contrast "eventually consistent".

items.question: Trong câu "An isolated old primary can still accept writes that are discarded when it rejoins — min-replicas-to-write limits that.", từ "isolated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An isolated old primary can still accept writes that are discarded when it rejoins — min-replicas-to-write limits that.", what does "isolated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: isolated /ˈaɪ.sə.leɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): bị cô lập. Node "isolated" do phân vùng mạng vẫn chạy nhưng không thấy các node khác.
items.explanationEn: isolated /ˈaɪ.sə.leɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): cut off. A node isolated by a network partition keeps running but cannot see the others.

items.question: Trong câu "Run at least 3 Sentinels in independent failure domains; clients must be Sentinel-aware instead of hard-coding the primary.", từ "hard-code" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Run at least 3 Sentinels in independent failure domains; clients must be Sentinel-aware instead of hard-coding the primary.", what does "hard-code" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to fix a value in code
items.explanation: hard-code /ˌhɑːdˈkəʊd/ (động từ): viết cứng vào mã. Giá trị "hard-coded" không đổi được khi chạy; nên đọc từ cấu hình hoặc service discovery.
items.explanationEn: hard-code /ˌhɑːdˈkəʊd/ (verb): to fix a value in code. Hard-coded values cannot change at runtime; read them from config or discovery instead.

items.question: Trong câu "Run at least 3 Sentinels in independent failure domains; clients must be Sentinel-aware instead of hard-coding the primary.", từ "independent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Run at least 3 Sentinels in independent failure domains; clients must be Sentinel-aware instead of hard-coding the primary.", what does "independent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: independent /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt/ (tính từ): độc lập. "Independent failure domains" = sự cố ở vùng này không kéo sập vùng kia (ví dụ khác AZ).
items.explanationEn: independent /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt/ (adjective): not affected by one another. Independent failure domains fail separately, such as different Availability Zones.

items.question: Trong câu "Sentinel improves availability, not write capacity.", từ "availability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sentinel improves availability, not write capacity.", what does "availability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: availability /əˌveɪ.ləˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): độ sẵn sàng. "High availability" (HA) = hệ thống vẫn phục vụ khi một thành phần hỏng.
items.explanationEn: availability /əˌveɪ.ləˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): staying up and serving. High availability (HA) means the system keeps serving when a component fails.

items.question: Trong câu "Sentinel improves availability, not write capacity.", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sentinel improves availability, not write capacity.", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (danh từ): sức chứa tối đa. "Write capacity" = lượng ghi tối đa hệ thống chịu được; thêm replica không tăng nó.
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (noun): maximum load. Write capacity is the most writes a system can take; adding replicas does not raise it.

items.question: Trong câu "Redis Cluster shards data across primaries:", từ "shard" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Redis Cluster shards data across primaries:", what does "shard" (verb) mean?
options: nhân bản dữ liệu y hệt
chia dữ liệu ra nhiều máy
items.explanation: shard /ʃɑːd/ (động từ): chia dữ liệu ra nhiều máy. "Shard" (danh từ) = một phần dữ liệu; "sharding" giúp tăng dung lượng ghi.
items.explanationEn: shard /ʃɑːd/ (verb): to split data across nodes. The noun "shard" is one partition of data; sharding raises write capacity.

options: trao đổi trạng thái ngang hàng
gửi lệnh từ máy chủ trung tâm
optionsEn: to share state peer to peer
items.explanation: gossip /ˈɡɒs.ɪp/ (động từ): trao đổi trạng thái ngang hàng. "Gossip protocol" = các node tự lan truyền thông tin cho nhau, không cần máy chủ trung tâm.
items.explanationEn: gossip /ˈɡɒs.ɪp/ (verb): to share state peer to peer. A gossip protocol spreads information node to node with no central server.

optionsEn: to sit in the same place
items.explanation: co-locate /ˌkəʊ.ləʊˈkeɪt/ (động từ): nằm cùng một chỗ. Key "co-locate" nằm cùng slot nên dùng được trong lệnh nhiều key.
items.explanationEn: co-locate /ˌkəʊ.ləʊˈkeɪt/ (verb): to sit in the same place. Keys that co-locate share a slot, so multi-key commands can use them.

items.question: Trong câu "Release must check ownership atomically — a bare DEL could remove a lock that expired and was taken by someone else:", từ "ownership" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Release must check ownership atomically — a bare DEL could remove a lock that expired and was taken by someone else:", what does "ownership" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ownership /ˈəʊ.nə.ʃɪp/ (danh từ): quyền sở hữu. "Check ownership" = kiểm tra khoá có đúng là của mình (qua token) trước khi xoá.
items.explanationEn: ownership /ˈəʊ.nə.ʃɪp/ (noun): who owns it. "Check ownership" means verifying the lock is yours (by token) before deleting it.

items.question: Trong câu "Release must check ownership atomically — a bare DEL could remove a lock that expired and was taken by someone else:", từ "bare" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Release must check ownership atomically — a bare DEL could remove a lock that expired and was taken by someone else:", what does "bare" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bare /beə/ (tính từ): đơn thuần, trơn. "A bare DEL" = lệnh DEL đơn thuần, không kiểm tra token; tương tự "bare minimum".
items.explanationEn: bare /beə/ (adjective): plain, alone. "A bare DEL" is a plain DEL with no token check; compare "the bare minimum".

items.question: Trong câu "Process pauses — a GC pause longer than the TTL leaves the holder believing it still owns the lock.", từ "holder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Process pauses — a GC pause longer than the TTL leaves the holder believing it still owns the lock.", what does "holder" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: holder /ˈhəʊl.də/ (danh từ): bên đang giữ. "Lock holder" = tiến trình đang giữ khoá; "account holder" = chủ tài khoản.
items.explanationEn: holder /ˈhəʊl.də/ (noun): the one holding. A lock holder is the process holding the lock; an account holder owns an account.

items.question: Trong câu "Clock jumps distort expiry.", từ "distort" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clock jumps distort expiry.", what does "distort" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: distort /dɪˈstɔːt/ (động từ): làm sai lệch. "Distort" = làm sai sự thật/kết quả; đồng hồ nhảy khiến thời điểm hết hạn bị tính sai.
items.explanationEn: distort /dɪˈstɔːt/ (verb): to make inaccurate. "Distort" means making something inaccurate; clock jumps miscompute expiry.

items.question: Trong câu "Clock jumps distort expiry.", từ "expiry" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clock jumps distort expiry.", what does "expiry" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the end of a valid period
items.explanation: expiry /ɪkˈspaɪə.ri/ (danh từ): sự hết hạn. "Expiry" (Anh-Anh) ≈ "expiration" (Anh-Mỹ); "expiry date" = ngày hết hạn.
items.explanationEn: expiry /ɪkˈspaɪə.ri/ (noun): the end of a valid period. "Expiry" (British) matches "expiration" (American); "expiry date" is the end date.

items.question: Trong câu "It helps with failover but is disputed (Kleppmann's critique vs antirez's reply) because it still assumes bounded pauses and clock drift.", từ "dispute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It helps with failover but is disputed (Kleppmann's critique vs antirez's reply) because it still assumes bounded pauses and clock drift.", what does "dispute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dispute /dɪˈspjuːt/ (động từ): tranh cãi, bị phản bác. "Be disputed" = bị giới chuyên môn tranh luận, chưa có kết luận thống nhất.
items.explanationEn: dispute /dɪˈspjuːt/ (verb): to argue over. "Be disputed" means experts argue about it with no agreed conclusion.

items.question: Trong câu "It helps with failover but is disputed (Kleppmann's critique vs antirez's reply) because it still assumes bounded pauses and clock drift.", từ "critique" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It helps with failover but is disputed (Kleppmann's critique vs antirez's reply) because it still assumes bounded pauses and clock drift.", what does "critique" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: critique /krɪˈtiːk/ (danh từ): bài phê bình. "Critique" là bài phân tích; người viết là "critic"; động từ "criticise".
items.explanationEn: critique /krɪˈtiːk/ (noun): a critical analysis. A critique is the analysis; the writer is a "critic"; the verb is "criticise".

items.question: Trong câu "It helps with failover but is disputed (Kleppmann's critique vs antirez's reply) because it still assumes bounded pauses and clock drift.", từ "bounded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It helps with failover but is disputed (Kleppmann's critique vs antirez's reply) because it still assumes bounded pauses and clock drift.", what does "bounded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bounded /ˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (tính từ): có giới hạn. "Bounded pauses" = giả định khoảng dừng không bao giờ vượt quá một mức đã biết.
items.explanationEn: bounded /ˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (adjective): having a limit. "Bounded pauses" assumes pauses never exceed a known amount.

items.question: Trong câu "It helps with failover but is disputed (Kleppmann's critique vs antirez's reply) because it still assumes bounded pauses and clock drift.", từ "drift" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It helps with failover but is disputed (Kleppmann's critique vs antirez's reply) because it still assumes bounded pauses and clock drift.", what does "drift" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: drift /drɪft/ (danh từ): độ lệch dần dần. "Clock drift" = đồng hồ các máy chạy lệch nhau dần; "configuration drift" = cấu hình lệch dần.
items.explanationEn: drift /drɪft/ (noun): a gradual deviation. Clock drift is machines' clocks slowly diverging; compare "configuration drift".

items.question: Trong câu "For correctness (money, stock), the protected resource must check a fencing token — an increasing number issued with the lock; storage rejects any token older than one already seen — or use etcd/ZooKeeper or database constraints.", từ "issue" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For correctness (money, stock), the protected resource must check a fencing token — an increasing number issued with the lock; storage rejects any token older than one already seen — or use etcd/ZooKeeper or database constraints.", what does "issue" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: issue /ˈɪʃ.uː/ (động từ): cấp phát, phát hành. "Issue a token/certificate" = cấp token/chứng chỉ; danh từ "issue" lại là vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: issue /ˈɪʃ.uː/ (verb): to hand out. "Issue a token or certificate" means handing it out; the noun "issue" means a problem.

items.question: Trong câu "For correctness (money, stock), the protected resource must check a fencing token — an increasing number issued with the lock; storage rejects any token older than one already seen — or use etcd/ZooKeeper or database constraints.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For correctness (money, stock), the protected resource must check a fencing token — an increasing number issued with the lock; storage rejects any token older than one already seen — or use etcd/ZooKeeper or database constraints.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc dữ liệu. "Database constraints" như UNIQUE, CHECK, FOREIGN KEY giúp từ chối dữ liệu sai.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a rule data must obey. Database constraints such as UNIQUE, CHECK and FOREIGN KEY reject invalid data.

items.question: Trong câu "Stateless app servers store SET session:<id> <json> EX 1800, refreshing the TTL on activity.", từ "stateless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stateless app servers store SET session:<id> <json> EX 1800, refreshing the TTL on activity.", what does "stateless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stateless /ˈsteɪt.ləs/ (tính từ): không lưu trạng thái. Server "stateless" để trạng thái ở nơi chung (Redis), nên dễ thêm bớt máy.
items.explanationEn: stateless /ˈsteɪt.ləs/ (adjective): keeping no local state. Stateless servers keep state in a shared store like Redis, so scaling is easy.

items.question: Trong câu "Stateless app servers store SET session:<id> <json> EX 1800, refreshing the TTL on activity.", từ "refresh" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stateless app servers store SET session:<id> <json> EX 1800, refreshing the TTL on activity.", what does "refresh" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: refresh /rɪˈfreʃ/ (động từ): đặt lại từ đầu. "Refresh the TTL" = đặt lại thời gian sống mỗi khi người dùng còn hoạt động (sliding session).
items.explanationEn: refresh /rɪˈfreʃ/ (verb): to reset afresh. "Refresh the TTL" resets the lifetime whenever the user is active (a sliding session).

items.question: Trong câu "Every instance behind the load balancer sees the same session.", từ "instance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every instance behind the load balancer sees the same session.", what does "instance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: instance /ˈɪn.stəns/ (danh từ): máy chủ đang chạy. "Instance" trong hạ tầng = một bản chạy của ứng dụng; "for instance" = ví dụ.
items.explanationEn: instance /ˈɪn.stəns/ (noun): a running server. In infrastructure an instance is one running copy; "for instance" means "for example".

items.question: Trong câu "The script makes INCR + EXPIRE atomic; two separate calls could leave a counter without a TTL if the app crashed between them.", từ "crash" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The script makes INCR + EXPIRE atomic; two separate calls could leave a counter without a TTL if the app crashed between them.", what does "crash" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: crash /kræʃ/ (động từ): bị sập. "The app crashed" = ứng dụng chết đột ngột; "crash-safe" = an toàn khi sập.
items.explanationEn: crash /kræʃ/ (verb): to fail suddenly. "The app crashed" means it died unexpectedly; "crash-safe" means safe if that happens.

items.question: Trong câu "A sliding window uses a sorted set per user: ZREMRANGEBYSCORE old timestamps, ZADD now, ZCARD.", từ "sliding" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sliding window uses a sorted set per user: ZREMRANGEBYSCORE old timestamps, ZADD now, ZCARD.", what does "sliding" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sliding /ˈslaɪ.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): trượt theo thời gian. "Sliding window" luôn xét N giây gần nhất, khác "fixed window" chia theo mốc cố định.
items.explanationEn: sliding /ˈslaɪ.dɪŋ/ (adjective): moving forward with time. A sliding window always covers the last N seconds, unlike a fixed window with set boundaries.

items.question: Trong câu "Memcached is multi-threaded and stores opaque strings with no persistence or replication; choose it only for a simple, huge string cache.", từ "opaque" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Memcached is multi-threaded and stores opaque strings with no persistence or replication; choose it only for a simple, huge string cache.", what does "opaque" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: opaque /əʊˈpeɪk/ (tính từ): không đọc được bên trong. "Opaque value" = hệ thống chỉ lưu và trả nguyên khối, không hiểu nội dung bên trong.
items.explanationEn: opaque /əʊˈpeɪk/ (adjective): with hidden structure. An opaque value is stored and returned as a blob without the system understanding it.

items.question: Trong câu "Hardening: never expose 6379 publicly, enable ACLs and TLS (Redis 6+), keep protected-mode yes, and watch SLOWLOG GET, evictions and replication lag.", từ "hardening" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hardening: never expose 6379 publicly, enable ACLs and TLS (Redis 6+), keep protected-mode yes, and watch SLOWLOG GET, evictions and replication lag.", what does "hardening" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hardening /ˈhɑː.dən.ɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc gia cố bảo mật. "Security hardening" = giảm bề mặt tấn công: tắt cổng thừa, bật xác thực, mã hoá.
items.explanationEn: hardening /ˈhɑː.dən.ɪŋ/ (noun): making a system more secure. Security hardening shrinks the attack surface: close ports, enable auth and encryption.

items.question: Trong câu "Hardening: never expose 6379 publicly, enable ACLs and TLS (Redis 6+), keep protected-mode yes, and watch SLOWLOG GET, evictions and replication lag.", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hardening: never expose 6379 publicly, enable ACLs and TLS (Redis 6+), keep protected-mode yes, and watch SLOWLOG GET, evictions and replication lag.", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): để lộ ra ngoài. "Expose a port" = mở cổng cho bên ngoài truy cập; Redis không nên lộ ra Internet.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to make reachable. "Expose a port" makes it reachable from outside; Redis should never face the Internet.

items.question: Trong câu "Hardening: never expose 6379 publicly, enable ACLs and TLS (Redis 6+), keep protected-mode yes, and watch SLOWLOG GET, evictions and replication lag.", từ "lag" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hardening: never expose 6379 publicly, enable ACLs and TLS (Redis 6+), keep protected-mode yes, and watch SLOWLOG GET, evictions and replication lag.", what does "lag" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: lag /læɡ/ (danh từ): độ tụt lại phía sau. "Replication lag" = replica tụt sau primary bao lâu; lag lớn thì failover mất nhiều dữ liệu hơn.
items.explanationEn: lag /læɡ/ (noun): how far it falls behind. Replication lag is how far a replica trails the primary; large lag means more loss on failover.

items.question: Trong câu "Redis keeps data structures in RAM and runs commands one at a time, giving atomic operations and sub-millisecond latency.", từ "latency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Redis keeps data structures in RAM and runs commands one at a time, giving atomic operations and sub-millisecond latency.", what does "latency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: latency /ˈleɪ.tən.si/ (danh từ): độ trễ phản hồi. "Low latency" = phản hồi nhanh; đo bằng mili giây hoặc phân vị như p99.
items.explanationEn: latency /ˈleɪ.tən.si/ (noun): the delay before a response. Low latency means fast responses, measured in milliseconds or percentiles like p99.

items.question: Trong câu "TTLs plus a deliberate eviction policy make a bounded cache; noeviction protects data stores.", từ "deliberate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TTLs plus a deliberate eviction policy make a bounded cache; noeviction protects data stores.", what does "deliberate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: deliberate /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət/ (tính từ): có chủ đích. Tính từ đọc /-ət/, còn động từ "deliberate" /-eɪt/ = cân nhắc.
items.explanationEn: deliberate /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət/ (adjective): done on purpose. The adjective ends in /-ət/; the verb "deliberate" /-eɪt/ means to think carefully.

items.question: Trong câu "RDB and AOF trade recovery point against cost; async replication means failover may lose recent writes.", từ "trade against" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RDB and AOF trade recovery point against cost; async replication means failover may lose recent writes.", what does "trade against" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to give up one for another
items.explanation: trade against /treɪd əˈɡenst/ (cụm từ): đánh đổi. "Trade A against B" = được A thì mất B; danh từ liên quan: "trade-off" (sự đánh đổi).
items.explanationEn: trade against /treɪd əˈɡenst/ (phrase): to give up one for another. "Trade A against B" means gaining one at the cost of the other; noun: "trade-off".

items.question: Trong câu "Sessions, leaderboards, rate limiters and efficiency locks are natural fits within those limits.", từ "natural fit" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sessions, leaderboards, rate limiters and efficiency locks are natural fits within those limits.", what does "natural fit" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: natural fit /ˈnætʃ.ər.əl fɪt/ (cụm từ): sự phù hợp tự nhiên. "X is a natural fit for Y" = X hợp với Y một cách hiển nhiên, không cần gượng ép.
items.explanationEn: natural fit /ˈnætʃ.ər.əl fɪt/ (phrase): an obviously suitable choice. "X is a natural fit for Y" means X suits Y obviously, without forcing it.

items.question: Trong câu "Each data type maps to a need: counters, objects, queues, uniqueness, rankings, event logs.", từ "uniqueness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each data type maps to a need: counters, objects, queues, uniqueness, rankings, event logs.", what does "uniqueness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: uniqueness /juˈniːk.nəs/ (danh từ): tính không trùng lặp. "Enforce uniqueness" = bảo đảm không có giá trị trùng; Set trong Redis làm việc này.
items.explanationEn: uniqueness /juˈniːk.nəs/ (noun): having no duplicates. "Enforce uniqueness" means ensuring no duplicate values; a Redis Set does that.
